description: PHP class 'Text' providing dynamic text management, translation, HTML processing, URL handling, and social sharing features within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for managing dynamic texts, translations, HTML content, URL processing, and social sharing within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a translated text, compatible with Lang::trans().

methods.name: sys
methods.description: Retrieves a system language translation.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Gets the specified text in a given language, with variable substitution.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Returns text as HTML, deprecated.

methods.name: plain
methods.description: Returns text without HTML tags.

methods.name: slash
methods.description: Returns text with escaped quotes for JavaScript.

methods.name: isHtml
methods.description: Checks if a text ID is marked as HTML.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all texts with optional filters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a text translation.

methods.name: setPending
methods.description: Marks a text translation as pending.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a text by ID and language.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns groups of texts.

methods.name: wcount
methods.description: Counts words in a string, excluding HTML tags.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts words in database content sections.

methods.name: widget
methods.description: Generates embed code for project widgets.

methods.name: shareLinks
methods.description: Generates social media share URLs.

methods.name: GmapsLink
methods.description: Creates a Google Maps link for a location.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Removes non-ASCII characters from a string.

methods.name: urliza
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly string from text.

methods.name: recorta
methods.description: Recorta un texto a una longitud específica, respetando HTML.

methods.name: ultima_palabra
methods.description: Obtiene la última palabra de un texto.

methods.name: cerrar_etiquetas
methods.description: Cierra etiquetas HTML abiertas en un fragmento.

methods.name: urlink
methods.description: Convierte URLs en enlaces HTML en un texto plano.

methods.name: cutUrlParams
methods.description: Elimina parámetros de una URL.

methods.name: tags_filter
methods.description: Elimina etiquetas script, iframe, form y object del HTML.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Devuelve errores de traducción no encontrados.
